posts.title: Thirteen years ago I failed at their dream
posts.description: It was expected that I become a doctor, just like them. They wanted me to become confident, worldly, athletic, respected, important; something they could be proud of. I was never interested in medicine. I was interested in everything else: swimming in the lake, how hydropower plants worked, Rube Goldberg machines, climbing trees, airplanes. posts.title: You can have a little fun, as a treat
posts.description: I took philosophy 101 as a freshman. I memorized the difference between modus tollens and modus ponens and tried to figure out what St Anselm was getting at in his ontological argument.
